simple.meaning: כִּימָה (Kîymâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a cluster of stars , i.e. the Pleiades.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: כִּימָה (H3598) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 9:9, with occurrences in Job, Amos.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כִּימָה (H3598) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כִּימָה (H3598) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כִּימָה (Kîymâh) / H3598 is traced through Job 9:9, Job 38:31, Amos 5:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a cluster of stars , i.e. the Pleiades
definitions.full: H3598. Kimah כִּימָה noun feminine perhaps Pleiades (see above; Late Hebrew id. ; ᵑ6 כִּימָא, ᵑ7 ) — as made by ׳י , Amos 5:8 (|| כְּסִיל ), Job 9:9 (|| תֵמָן חַדְרֵי כְּסִיל, עָשׁ, ); and under his control, כ ׳מַעֲדַנּוֺת 38:31 (|| כְּסִיל משְׁכוֺת ). — (Stern Jüd. Zeitschr. f. Wissen. u. Leben. iii.((1864-65) 258 ff. Nö in Schenkel BL Hoffm ZAW iii. 107 ff. interpret עשׁ as Pleiades, and כימה as Sirius).
